title: Oscar and the Machine
author: Freya Thornbury
blurb: Jude Thackeray, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
